en: I'm an aspiring head dresser, not a magician!

I should be able to style that head after I complete my studies. Considering the current state of the kingdom, expect a waiting time of about one or two eternities, and it's the most reasonable timeline.
Oh what, are you for real?! I'm just a beginner! No way I can do anything about that, sorry.
I deal in hairs, not miracles!
Your sacrifice has been accepted...
Mama has blessed you!
A miracle... it's a miracle...
We need more sacrifices!
...more sacrifices...
Welcome to our humble chapel, brother! Are you ready to make a sacrifice?
Pray for your salvation... with a sacrifice.
Words are meaningless, only sacrifices are important...
Are you really faithful?
Prove your devotion!
Mama, protect this lost child...
Sacrifice will save you...
A new disciple!
Repent...
She sees you, and she smiles!
Come closer, my child.
You're back... So faithful!
That hat is really heavy.
THE SACRIFICE!
Pick which enemies you want to fight and press the button.
You can also select a zone and all the enemies in the room will turn into ones taken from that zone!
Remember: you can't die here. You'll just go back to the entrance.
Give it your all!
In case you forgot how my training room works...
Just pick your gear, choose your mutations and go kill some enemies!
Behind the first door, you can fight any enemy you have already encountered.
There are also big doors at the back of the room, but I don't know where they lead...
Hello there! Welcome to the Combat Room!
I'm handling it for my knightly friend. You can call it undead solidarity.
You can even select enemies from a specific zone of the island and instantly fill the room with them!
Oh and don't worry: you can't die here. You'll just go back to the entrance.
Give it your all and train like crazy!
Oh hi there. I'm not dead anymore!
Welcome to my very own training room!
Hello again!
It's great to see you invested in your training!
No pain, no gain!
Are you still eager to practice? You're in the right place!
It's all about training here... Kill or die trying!
And maybe try again.
So this is where these doors lead! Neat!
I guess it works just like the other room, so go ahead and train all you want.
Once more unto the breach, I see?
Good training!
And once again, don't fear death.
Condition: take no damage in the previous level.
Condition: kill ::n:: enemies without taking any damage.
::n:: boss cells required
Go Back! Bring me more Cells!
Just a few more!
Don't be such a cheapskate! Share with your old pal!
Have you ever seen anything so beautiful?
Who's a good boy?
Bring me more, you wretched blob!
I need it! One last time!
Nothing beats the thrill of fighting your archenemy!
You fought well, Belmont. Gloves off it is, then.
By killing you, I'll end your accursed bloodline!
You Belmonts are formidable opponents.
I think I'd be bored if it wasn't for your family resisting me.
This Castle isn't big enough for the both of us!
Pushed to my limits by a mere copycat, me?!
You are but a bug to squash.
You're not even a Belmont.
What are you hoping to achieve? I am the Dark Lord!
Nice try. Let's see how you do against this.
Bah, what a waste of time...
It has been a long time since someone stood against me like this.
Feeling tired, Belmont?
Your ancestor was doing way better...
Well dodged, your predecessor would have been proud...
I'm slightly disappointed.
Your whole clan opposed me generation after generation and yet, here I still am.
Our two families used to be friends, a long time ago. If only you Belmonts had more ambition...
Give me back this outfit!
Die, usurper!
You're not on my level, small-time vampire!
The bad vampire hunter sees something and just hit it with his whip. The good vampire hunter sees something and hit it with his whip, but it's different...
You may have copied my appearance, but I'm not a mere vampire, I am Count Dracula!
Even my son can masquerade as a more convincing vampire...
I've been a good sport up until now, but this fight has been going on for too long. Die!
You can't compare to the Belmont.
I'm wasting my time, fighting with you.
You didn't think you could defeat me, did you?
So weak... how could such a worthless being defeat Death?
I've seen enough, time to perish now.
Damned feline!
Argh! I'll kill you 9 times to make you pay if I have to!
Who brings their pet to a fateful fight, seriously?
Wounded by a mere cat?! Me?!
Bold of you to summon my own magic against me.
Leave my bats alone!
Stop using my familiars against their master!
My children! No!
Rah! Those Belmonts and their accursed whip!
